sn12.19:1.2: Avijjānīvaraṇassa bhikkhave bālassa taṇhāya sampayuttassa evam ayaṃ kāyo samudāgato ||
sn12.19:1.3: Iti ayaṃ ceva kāyo bahiddhā ca nāmarūpam || itthetaṃ dvayaṃ dvayaṃ paṭicca phasso saḷevāyatanāni || yehi phuṭṭho bālo sukhadukkham paṭisaṃvediyati || etesaṃ vā aññatarena || || 3
sn12.19:2.1: Avijjānīvaraṇassa bhikkhave paṇḍitassa taṇhāya sampayuttassa evam ayaṃ kāyo samudāgato ||
sn12.19:2.2: Iti ayaṃ ceva kāyo bahiddhā ca nāmarūpaṃ || itthetaṃ dvayaṃ dvayaṃ paṭicca phasso saḷevāyatanāni || yehi phuṭṭho paṇḍito sukhadukkhaṃ paṭisaṃvediyati || etesaṃ vā aññatarena || || 4
sn12.19:3.1: Tatra bhikkhave ko viseso ko adhippāyo kiṃ nānākaraṇaṃ paṇḍitassa bālenāti || || 5
sn12.19:3.2: Bhagavaṃ-mūlakā no bhante dhammā Bhagavaṃnettikā Bhagavaṃ- paṭisaraṇā || Sādhu vata bhante Bhagavantaṃ yeva paṭibhātu etassa bhāsitassa attho || Bhagavato sutvā bhikkhū dhāressantīti || || 6
sn12.19:4.1: Tena hi bhikkhave suṇātha sādhukam manasi karotha bhāsissāmiti || ||
sn12.19:4.2: Evam bhante ti kho te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassosuṃ || || 7
sn12.19:5.1: Yāya bhikkhave avijjāya nivutassa bālassa yāya ca taṇhāya sampayuttassa ayaṃ kāyo samudāgato || Sā ceva avijjā bālassa appahīnā sā ca taṇhā aparikkhīṇā || ||
sn12.19:5.3: Na bhikkhave bālo acari brahmacariyaṃ sammādukkhakkhayāya ||
sn12.19:5.4: tasmā bālo kāyassa bhedā kāyūpago hoti ||
sn12.19:5.5: So kāyūpago samāno na parimuccati jātiyā jaramaraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi
sn12.19:6.1: Yāya ca bhikkhave avijjāya nivutassa paṇḍitassa yāya ca taṇhāya sampayuttassa ayaṃ kāyo samudāgato || Sā ceva avijjā paṇḍitassa pahīnā sā ca taṇhā parikkhīṇā ||
sn12.19:6.4: tasmā paṇḍito kāyassa bhedā na kāyūpago hoti ||
sn12.19:6.5: So akāyūpago samāno parimuccati jātiyā jarāmaraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi
sn12.19:6.7: Ayam kho bhikkhave viseso ayam adhippāyo idam nānākaraṇam paṇḍitassa bālena yad idaṃ brahmacariyavāso ti || ||
